pois.name: Vleeshuis
pois.openingHours: Th-Su,PH 10:00-17:00; Jan 1 off; May 1 off; Nov 1 off; Dec 25 off; easter +39 days off; easter +1 day 10:00-17:00; easter +50 days 10:00-17:00
pois.intro: The Vleeshuis in Antwerp, Belgium, is a former guildhall. It is now a museum located between the Drie Hespenstraat, the Repenstraat and the Vleeshouwersstraat.

pois.name: Het Letterenhuis
pois.intro: The Letterenhuis is a Belgian non-profit organization located in Antwerp. The Letterenhuis collects and archives information of Flemish artists, musicians, and writers, as well as portraits concerning Flemish culture as from 1750.

pois.name: MoMu
pois.intro: MoMu is the fashion museum of the City of Antwerp, Belgium and collects, conserves, studies and exhibits the largest collection of historical and contemporary designer fashion in Belgium, and holds the largest collection of Belgian fashion in the world.

pois.name: Plantin-Moretusmuseum
pois.openingHours: Tu-Su 10:00-17:00; Jan 01 off; May 01 off; Nov 01 off; Dec 25 off; easter +39 days off
pois.intro: The Plantin–Moretus Museum is a museum in Antwerp, Belgium which showcases the history of printing in Antwerp and the prominent role played in that history by the family of printers founded by Christophe Plantin and Jan Moretus in Antwerp in the second half of the 16th century.

pois.name: Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekathedraal
pois.intro: The Cathedral of Our Lady is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Antwerp, Belgium. Today's seat of the Diocese of Antwerp started in 1352 and, although the first stage of construction was ended in 1521, has never been fully completed.

pois.name: Centraal Station
pois.intro: Antwerpen-Centraal railway station is the main railway station in Antwerp, Belgium. It is one of the most important hubs in the country and is one of the four Belgian stations on the high-speed rail network.

pois.name: Koninklijk Museum voor Schone Kunsten Antwerpen
pois.nameEnglish: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
pois.wikipedia: nl:Koninklijk Museum voor Schone Kunsten Antwerpen
pois.intro: The Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp is a museum in Antwerp, Belgium, founded in 1810, that houses a collection of paintings, sculptures and drawings from the fourteenth to the twentieth centuries. This collection is representative of the artistic production and the taste of art enthusiasts in Antwerp, Belgium and the Northern and Southern Netherlands since the 15th century.

pois.name: Rubenshuis
pois.openingHours: Tu-Su 10:00-17:00; Jan 01 off; May 01 off; Nov 01 off; Dec 25 off; easter +39 days off; easter +1 day 10:00-17:00; easter +50 days 10:00-17:00
pois.intro: The Rubenshuis is the former home and workshop of Peter Paul Rubens in Antwerp. Purchased in 1610, Rubens had the Flemish townhouse renovated and extended on the basis of designs by Rubens himself.

pois.name: Stadhuis Antwerpen
pois.intro: The City Hall of Antwerp, Belgium, stands on the western side of that city's Grote Markt. Erected between 1561 and 1565, after designs made by Cornelis Floris de Vriendt and several other architects and artists, this Renaissance building incorporates both Flemish and Italian influences.

pois.name: Boerentoren
pois.intro: The Boerentoren is a historic high-rise building in Antwerp, Belgium. Constructed between 1929 and 1932 and originally 87.5 m high, it remained the tallest building and the second-tallest structure in the city until 2019, when the Antwerp Tower surpassed it with a height of 100.7 m.

pois.name: Zoo Antwerpen
pois.description: Zoo-Koninklijke Maatschappij voor Dierkunde van Antwerpen (KMDA)
pois.intro: Antwerp Zoo is a zoo in the centre of Antwerp, Belgium, located next to the Antwerpen-Centraal railway station. The zoo is the oldest animal park in Belgium, and one of the oldest in the world; it was established on 21 July 1843.

pois.name: Het Steen
pois.intro: Het Steen is a medieval fortress in the old city centre of Antwerp, Belgium, one of Europe's biggest ports. The surviving structure was built between 1200 and 1225 as a gateway to a larger castle of the Dukes of Brabant which was demolished in the 19th century.

pois.name: Sint-Carolus Borromeuskerk
pois.intro: St. Charles Borromeo Church is a Roman Catholic church in central Antwerp, Belgium, located on the Hendrik Conscienceplein.

pois.name: AFAS Dome
pois.intro: The AFAS Dome is an indoor arena in Antwerp, Belgium. It is a multipurpose hall used for organizing concerts, sporting events, festivals, and fairs.

pois.name: Middelheimmuseum
pois.openingHours: Jan-Mar, Oct-Dec: Tu-Su,PH 10:00-17:00; Apr,May,Sep: Tu-Su,PH 10:00-19:00; Jun-Jul: Tu-Su,PH 10:00-21:00; Aug: Tu-Su,PH 10:00-20:00; Mo off; Jan 1 off; May 1 off; Nov 1 off; Dec 25 off; easter +39 days off
pois.intro: Middelheim Open Air Sculpture Museum is a sculpture park of 24 hectares in the park part of the Middelheim Nachtegalen Park at Antwerp. The Middelheim Museum collection has approximately 400 works of art on display.

pois.name: Sint-Pauluskerk
pois.intro: St. Paul's Church is a Roman Catholic church located at the Veemarkt in Antwerp, Belgium.

pois.name: Handelsbeurs
pois.intro: The Stock Exchange, Antwerp or Handelsbeurs is a building in Antwerp, Belgium, which opened in 1531 as the world's first purpose-built commodity exchange. The architectural design of the Royal Exchange in London was inspired by the Flemish style of the Antwerp Stock Exchange building.

pois.name: M HKA - Museum van Hedendaagse Kunst Antwerpen
pois.openingHours: Tu-Su 11:00-18:00; Th 11:00-21:00; Jan 1 off; May 1 off; Dec 25 off; Dec 24 11:00-16:00; Dec 31 11:00-16:00; easter + 39 days off
pois.intro: The Museum of Contemporary Art in Antwerp is the contemporary art museum of the city of Antwerp, Belgium. Its current director is Bart de Baere.

pois.name: Fotomuseum Antwerpen
pois.intro: Fotomuseum Antwerp, also known as FOMU, is a museum of photography in Antwerp, Belgium.

pois.name: Maagdenhuis
pois.intro: The Maagdenhuis Museum is an art museum and historical museum located in a 17th-century historic building on Lange Gasthuisstraat, Antwerp, Belgium. The building was used as an orphanage for the maegdeckens, or maidens, from the mid-16th century to the end of the 19th century.

pois.name: DIVA
pois.intro: DIVA Museum for Diamonds, Jewellery and Silver is a museum that opened in Antwerp, Belgium, in 2018. It merged the collections of the former Antwerp Diamond Museum and Sterckshof silver museum in a single institution.

pois.name: Snijders & Rockoxhuis
pois.description: Tu-Su 10:00-17:00; Jan 1, Jan 2 off; Dec 25 off; Dec 26 off; easter+39 days off; easter+1 days 10:00-17:00; easter + 50 days 10:00-17:00
pois.intro: The Snijders&Rockox House is a museum in Antwerp, Belgium. It is located in two neighbouring townhouses formerly owned by the artist Frans Snyders and the mayor Nicolaas Rockox.

pois.name: Red Star Line Museum
pois.intro: Das Red Star Line Museum in Antwerpen wurde 2013 in den ehemaligen Lagerhallen der belgischen Red-Star-Line-Reederei eröffnet. Es präsentiert hauptsächlich die europäische Migration nach Amerika.

pois.name: Eugeen Van Mieghem Museum
pois.openingHours: Su,Mo 14:00-17:00; Jul-Aug off; PH off; "groups by appointment"
pois.intro: Il museo Eugeen Van Mieghem è un museo di pittura di Anversa che ospita le opere del pittore belga Eugeen Van Mieghem. Il museo è ospitato all'interno del Het Redershuis, un palazzo di fine '800, riconosciuto come bene monumentale protetto per via del suo stile architettonico e per la pregevolezza dei suoi arredi d'interno.

pois.name: Bij Lam en Yin
pois.intro: Bij Lam en Yin est un restaurant chinois de Belgique étoilé au Guide Michelin.

pois.name: 't Fornuis
pois.intro: 't Fornuis is a restaurant located in the Reynderstraat in Antwerp, Belgium. It is a quality restaurant that has been awarded one Michelin star from 1986 to present.

pois.name: Brandbar
pois.description: Coffee bar and graphic design agency. Has coffee, tea, juices, soup, alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, lunch food.

pois.name: 't Zilte
pois.intro: Zilte is een restaurant in Antwerpen met drie Michelinsterren.

pois.name: Mero
pois.description: Mero is a fine dining restaurant where chef Altin Mero creates dishes with mediterranean, scandinavian and asian flavours.

pois.name: Shopping Stadsfeestzaal
pois.intro: Der Stadtfestsaal Antwerpen ist ein neoklassizistisches Gebäude, welches 1908 erbaut wurde.

pois.name: De Groene Waterman
pois.openingHours: Mo-Sa 09:30-18:00; Su off; Jul-Aug Mo off

pois.intro: Middelheim Open Air Sculpture Museum is a sculpture park of 24 hectares in the park part of the Middelheim Nachtegalen Park at Antwerp. The Middelheim Museum collection has approximately 400 works of art on display.

pois.name: Stadspark
pois.intro: Het Stadspark is een 14 ha groot park in het centrum van de Belgische stad Antwerpen. Het heeft de vorm van een driehoek waarvan de basis naar het zuiden en de top naar het noorden is gericht.

pois.name: Plantentuin
pois.intro: The Botanic Garden of Antwerp, which also carries the name Den Botaniek, is a landscaped botanical garden created in 1825 in the inner city of Antwerp located at the Leopoldstraat, covering an area of slightly less than 1 hectare.

pois.name: Nachtegalenpark
pois.intro: Nachtegalen Park is a park located in the Antwerp, Belgium municipality of Wilrijk. It served as the archery venue for the 1920 Summer Olympics.

pois.name: Koning Albertpark
pois.intro: Koning Albertpark is an urban public park in Antwerp, Belgium. Established in 1861 for public use, it occupies approximately 6.2 hectares, and serves as a green space in the southern district of the city.

pois.name: Hobokense Polder
pois.intro: Le polder d'Hoboken est une petite réserve naturelle créée dans un ancien polder situé à Hoboken, près d'Anvers en Belgique.

pois.name: 't Asbroek
pois.intro: 't Asbroek is a nature domain and forest in the municipality of Schoten, Belgium, covering an area of 12 ha. The domain is owned by the municipality of Schoten and managed by nature conservation organisation Natuurpunt since 1998.

pois.name: Fort 7
pois.description: Natura 2000: Historische fortengordels van Antwerpen als vleermuizenhabitats
pois.intro: Fort 7 is een fort gelegen te Wilrijk en onderdeel van de onder Henri Alexis Brialmont gebouwde Brialmontgordel. Er werd in 1859 aangevangen met de bouw en het werd voltooid in 1864.

pois.name: Paleis op de Meir
pois.intro: Das Koninklijk Paleis op de Meir ist ein Stadtpalais aus dem 18. Jahrhundert in der belgischen Stadt Antwerpen.

pois.name: Bourlaschouwburg
pois.intro: Bourla Theatre is a theatre located in Antwerp that seats around 900. The building is designed in a neoclassical style on the site of the former Tapissierspand tapestry market.

pois.name: Diamantkwartier
pois.intro: Antwerp's diamond district, also known as the Diamond Quarter, and dubbed the Square Mile, is an area within the city of Antwerp, Belgium. It consists of several square blocks covering an area of about one square mile.

pois.name: Sint-Walburgiskerk
pois.intro: St. Walburga Church or Burchtkerk was a Roman Catholic parish church in Antwerp, modern-day Belgium.

pois.name: Sorghvliedt
pois.intro: Sorghvliedt Castle is a building in Belgium with a history dating back to the 16th century. It was originally a farm building called Wickeleynde owned by the merchant Jean Plaquet and his wife Maria Leydeckers.
